description: This file defines the IDownloadManager interface for managing download operations, including starting, pausing, resuming, canceling downloads, and querying storage details. It also includes nested structures for options and notifications.

classes.name: IDownloadManager
classes.description: Interface for managing download operations, including download control, status notifications, and storage management.

classes.name: IDownloadManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for download status updates.

classes.name: IDownloadManager::Options
classes.description: Structure defining options for download requests, such as priority, retries, and rate limit.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register for download status change notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister from download status change notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialize the download manager with a service shell.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Start downloading a file from a URL with specified options.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a downloaded file using its locator.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieve storage quota and used space details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Set rate limiting for a specific download session.
